from invoices import load_invoices, ROWS
from spans import due_between


def test_three_positions():
    data = list(load_invoices())
    assert due_between(data, 2, 4) == [v for _, v in ROWS[1:4]]


def test_low_above_high():
    data = list(load_invoices())
    assert due_between(data, 3, 2) == []
